visual_action: A slideshow of still photos of Donald Trump. The photos appear heavily color-saturated, making his skin look bright orange. Text overlays appear sequentially, listing various accusations and statements attributed to him. The video alternates between a shot of him holding a hand up with the text 'WAIT!!' and a smiling close-up where the lists of claims appear.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: He is the only person shown in the video, identified by face, and all on-screen text is about him (e.g., 'Trump is a 34-count convicted felon').

on_screen_text.text: He's also been found liable for sexual assault
He's said he'd be a "dictator" on "day one"
He wants to abolish the Department of Education
He brags about overturning Roe v. Wade and banning abortion

spoken_summary: There is no spoken dialogue in the video. The audio consists only of music.
audio_music: A repetitive, slightly distorted electronic track plays throughout the video, creating a tense and unsettling atmosphere.
editing_pacing: The video is a slideshow with quick cuts between still images, followed by a slow zoom on a single photo as multiple lines of text appear sequentially.
manipulation_or_satire: The photos of Donald Trump are heavily color-saturated, making his skin appear an exaggerated and unnatural orange, likely to mock his appearance.
central_claim: Donald Trump is a dangerous and unfit candidate due to his criminal convictions, alleged sexual assault liability, and stated intentions to undermine the Constitution and abortion rights.
intended_effect: To persuade viewers that Donald Trump is a threat to the country and should not be elected.
